detail.longDescription: Macroeconomic meat grinder. Piled-up bills, grueling errands, & running defense in a system that treats all of us small # business owners like alleged money launderers. Came back into the # research bunker completely fried. And right on cue, my cardinal friend started squawking from his hidden station somewhere in the shrubs & trees, calling me out repeatedly until he calmed my nerves. 🎶 🐦 Feels like an Alfred Hitchcock movie, but it's just a # FridayFeeling . Find your sizzle in # birds & nature.
